tergm_model.framework: Temporal Exponential Random Graph Model (TERGM; Krivitsky & Handcock, 2014)
tergm_model.mathematical_formula: P(Y^{t+1} = y | Y^t = y^t) = exp(sum_k theta_k * g_k(y, y^t)) / kappa(theta, y^t)

parameter_estimates.interpretation: Extreme negative coefficient confirms persistent topological sparsity across all phases (density < 0.015)
Insignificant reciprocity proves communication operates as unilateral broadcast rather than bidirectional dialogue
Significant positive preferential attachment: citizens systematically target high-authority state sinks (@prabowo, @gerindra)
Statistically significant out-degree clustering centered exclusively on @grok, confirming AI displacement
Absence of significant triadic closure confirms networks consist of disconnected tree branches rather than cohesive coalitions

saom_model.framework: Stochastic Actor-Oriented Model (SAOM / SIENA; Snijders et al., 2010)
mechanisms: Rate Function lambda_i: Citizen participation rates scale monotonically during exogenous physical poisoning events
Evaluation Function: Out-degree cost beta_out < 0, Authority attractiveness beta_attract > 0
Algorithmic Substitution Effect: When state out-degree equals zero, tie-formation utility redirects toward AI agent @grok
